title: 🎃 Halloween 2026 Event + ⚔️ Boss Rush
changes: 🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT (Oct 3-31): Battle Tower bosses on floors 10, 20, 30... to earn Pumpkin Shards (1-3 per boss kill).

👑 6 Halloween titles: Pumpkin King (+5% gold, 20 shards), Phantom (+3% dodge, 10 shards), Slayer of the Demon King (+10% damage/crit/500 HP), Harbinger of Doom (+15% shadow dmg, clear Floor 100), Pumpkin Sovereign (+12% gold/XP, 500 shards), Phantom Lord (+7% dodge, 1000 dodges). Each has animated name effects!
🗡️ REAPER'S SCYTHE (Mythic): Buy in the Armory for 20 Pumpkin Shards + 50,000 gold. Yours forever!
⚔️ BOSS RUSH: New timed mode in Tower — race through bosses on floors 10→50. Best time saved!
⚡ 2X EVENTS: Staff can toggle 2x XP and 2x Gold from the GM console.
💪 BALANCE v26: All classes deal 2x attack damage.
🎃 Halloween app icon: Reinstall the PWA to get the jack-o'-lantern icon for October.
🛠️ Login fixed: session tokens now save to localStorage, stale sessions auto-clear.
🐾 Pets now regenerate HP over time in combat.
🌿 Druid spell icons fixed.

title: 🗼 Infinite Tower of Shadows
changes: A new endless mode in Battle: climb floor by floor against Tower Shades, with a Tower Warden boss every 10 floors as a DPS check.
Enemy power grows each floor — push as high as you can, then Sweep to collect rewards based on your best floor.
Milestone rewards at floors 25, 50, 75 and 100: Divine Blueprints, Mythic Eggs and exclusive titles (Tower Apprentice, Floor Master, Shadow Ascendant, Tower Conqueror).
Launch tuning: tower difficulty was reduced so early floors are a fair fight and the climb ramps up from there.

title: 🎨 Custom spell icons
changes: All 32 class spells now have hand-crafted art icons instead of emoji: 8 each for Hunter, Warrior, Mage and Druid.
Icons were optimized for mobile so they load instantly even on older phones.

title: 🔧 Fixes & polish
changes: Fixed a login crash caused by a duplicate variable in the game code.
Mobile header reworked into two rows: avatar and quick-nav on top, currencies and XP below.
Online player counter now reads the correct value from the server.
Armory restock, leaderboard name overflow and GM console ID click-to-fill all fixed.

title: 🌿 New class: Druid
changes: The Druid joins the roster — a Mana-based shapeshifter (+10% max HP, +10% attack, +5% dodge).

Eight new spells: Moonfire (damage + moonburn DoT), Wrath (2.5x strike), Rejuvenation (heal over time), Bear Form (+40% HP/+25% defense), Cat Form (+15% attack/+20% speed), Rake (strike + bleed), Regrowth (instant + over-time heal), Tranquility (big heal over time).
New Druid Grove background and class portrait included.

title: ⚖️ Level system rework & 🦸 Character panel rework
changes: Kill XP now capped at 5% of your current level — no more blasting through levels at high stages
New milestone rewards at levels 25/50/75/100: +1 class talent point (banked for upcoming talent trees) + commemorative title
Character panel fully reworked: bigger portrait on your class background, WoW-style layout
Your portrait now displays your actual equipped gear, each piece glowing its rarity color
Stats restyled as clean labeled rows across Offense, Defense, and Gains

title: 📣 Discord webhooks — bugs, feedback, patch notes & balance log
changes: 🐞 New bug reports now mirror instantly to the #bug-reports Discord channel
💬 Player feedback mirrors to #feedback the moment it is submitted
📜 Staff can push the latest patch notes to #patch-notes (read-only for players) with one button
⚖️ Staff can push the latest Balance Log entry to #balance-log the same way
🔗 Each channel webhook URL is configured on the staff page (owner/admin only)

title: ⚔️ Forge rework & spellbooks
changes: 🌌 Galaxy Forge moved into the Armory (Buy → Sell → Forge) — now forges all 5 slots: weapon, armor, helmet, boots, and trinket
🛠️ No more stat picking: the forge reads your class and builds the right gear automatically — primary stat, Stamina, Critical Strike, and Haste
🗑️ Old Gear Shop removed — the Inventory tab is now just Loadout, Upgrades, and loot
📖 Hunter, Warrior, and Mage now have full 8-spell books with 6 customizable spell slots
✨ New class resources: Focus (Hunter), Rage (Warrior), Mana (Mage), Energy (Rogue)
🧪 Enemies now drop potions (separate 8% chance) — restore health or class resource, 60s cooldown
🐾 Mend Pet now also grants +25% pet damage for 15s
🎟️ Class Change Tokens in the Token Shop (3 rebirth tokens) — swap class and keep your level, gear, and quests

title: ✨ Polish & Immersion update
changes: 🌙 Circadian realms: the game shifts to a deep-night palette from 10 PM–6 AM, with subtle seasonal tints through the year
🌦️ Atmosphere picker in Settings → Immersion: Clear, Rain, Fog, or Drifting ash — plus optional real-weather sync (off by default)
🎞️ Graphics profiles: SD, HD, or 4K — pick the fidelity your device handles best, layered with the existing anti-lag and FPS controls
🎵 Two new procedural tracks: 👑 Dread Sovereign (boss theme) and 🌠 Starfall Drift, plus separate Music and SFX volume sliders
⚔️ Boss fights now swell into the boss theme, then return to your previous track — toggleable in Immersion settings
🛠️ Fresh polish in this patch: cleaner Friends tab layout on phones and a softer, more natural rain effect

title: 🌐 Realm Network — global player origins
changes: New 🌐 Realm Network button on the Ranks tab: a live constellation of where players are connecting from
HD mode renders an animated starfield; simpler modes show a clean region list — region counts only, no personal data, ever

title: 👑 Staff titles & name effects
changes: 16 staff-only titles (7 GM, 6 Admin, 3 Owner) unlock automatically at login by role — equip them in the Titles tab, below the token titles
6 new staff-only name effects in Settings → Name Style: 🔨 Gavelstrike + 👁️ All-Seeing (GM), 🌍 Worldforge + 📐 Archlight (Admin), 👑 Shadowcrown + ♾️ Everflame (Owner)
Titles and name effects stack — e.g. wear 🌌 the Galaxywatcher with 👑 Shadowcrown
Players can never unlock or buy these; they never appear in the token shop

title: 📜 Character sheet, class backgrounds & staff titles
changes: 🧍 New character sheet: tap your hero panel for a WoW-style paper-doll view — gear slots, live stats, and your active pet (hover or long-press gear for details)
🎨 6 class backgrounds: Hunter's Dawn, Warrior's Stand, Mage Spire, Assassin's Night, Necropolis, Bloodrage Field — pick any in Settings
⚔️ Class-flavored gear names: bows for hunters, daggers for assassins, plate for warriors, shrouds for necromancers, and more
👑 16 new staff titles for GMs, Admins, and the Owner — spot them in chat and on the leaderboard

title: 💀 Necromancer & 🩸 Berserker — new hero classes
changes: ✨ 2 new hero classes join the roster: 💀 Necromancer (+15% attack, +10% crit damage, −10% max HP) and 🩸 Berserker (+30% attack, +10% attack speed, −15% defense)
Both appear in character creation alongside Hunter, Warrior, Mage, and Assassin

title: 🐛 Pet selling fixed
changes: 🐛 Fixed sold pets staying visible in the Pets tab — the tab now refreshes correctly after every sale
Sales were always going through (gold was added); only the display was stuck

title: 👑 Throne of Shadows
changes: 🔧 The game is now officially Throne of Shadows — new name, same game, live at throne-of-shadows.onrender.com

title: 🌀 Rebirth replaces Prestige · Hunters field 2 pets
changes: Prestige is gone — the new 🌀 Rebirth button (level 70+) returns you to level 1 while keeping your stage, gold, gear, pets, and titles; no stacking bonus
Old prestige counts carry over as rebirths, and prestige titles/achievements now track rebirths
Hunters can now field 2 pets at once: set any second pet from the Party tab — both fight, both earn XP, both bond bonuses apply
Level cap stays at 70 — saves above 70 clamp down on load

title: Level cap raised to 120
changes: Level cap raised from 70 to 120 — XP, GM grants, and loaded saves can never push past 120
Prestige now unlocks at level 120 (still +25% damage & gold per prestige, still resets to level 1)

title: Prestige at 70 & new titles
changes: Prestige now requires level 70 (was stage 50) — more runway before each rebirth
3 new prestige titles: the Paragon (10 prestiges), the Demigod (25), the Worldforger (50)

title: ♾️ Infinite gold perk
changes: ♾️ Infinite gold perk (owner-only): purchases never deduct gold, the HUD shows ∞, and it survives prestige — toggled from the GM console

title: 🛠️ Staff tab
changes: New 🛠️ Staff tab in the main navigation for owner, admins, and moderators — opens the GM console (give stats, ban, broadcasts) in one tap; invisible to regular players

title: Enemy icons fixed
changes: Every enemy now has its own matching icon (Frost Wisp 👻, Stone Sentinel 🗿, dragons 🐉…) instead of a random one

title: Admin & Mod badges
changes: New 🛡️ Admin and 🔨 Mod badges — shown next to names on the leaderboard and profile
Moderator role pill now has its own styled badge in the HUD and profile
Desktop revamp: sidebar navigation, two-column battle layout, richer HUD — plus a smoother motion pass everywhere (Modern theme) and light mobile refinements

title: 10 new titles
changes: 10 new hero titles: prestige titles (the Reborn, the Phoenix, the Immortal), boss titles (the Executioner, the Godslayer), gold titles (the Hoarder, the Magnate — lifetime gold earned is now tracked), and raid titles (the Raider, the Stormcaller, the Tidebreaker)

title: Voidwalker & Dragonscale gear sets
changes: New Voidwalker Regalia gear set (dodge/crit themed, purple-black aura) — grantable from the GM console
New Dragonscale Aegis gear set (HP/regen themed, red-gold aura) — grantable from the GM console

title: New titles, raid mode & guilds
changes: 9 new hero titles: playtime titles (the Sleepless, the Tireless, the Eternal), stage titles (the Climber, the Ascendant, the Mythical) and kill titles (the Slayer, the Butcher, the Annihilator)
The latest server broadcast is now publicly readable so the client can show announcements
Raid mode: endless PvE waves with boss waves every 5, best-wave record survives prestige
Guilds: create, join, leave, and view your guild roster from the More tab
Reskinned login screen with dark-fantasy styling

title: Moderator role & GM commands
changes: New moderator staff role with broadcast and player-lookup tools
New GM commands: unlock titles, set stage, ban/unban with login enforcement, server-wide broadcasts, player list search, and full save reset

title: Leaderboard badges & flags, number fixes
changes: Fixed companion damage numbers showing "false60" — crits now display properly
Floating damage numbers now pop, rise and fade smoothly
Creator badges: YouTuber, Streamer and VIP badges shown next to names on the leaderboard
Country flags: pick your country in Profile and its flag appears on the leaderboard
New live damage meter: per-fighter DPS bars that update every second
Party overhaul: member cards with portraits, roles and live HP bars
Hero titles: unlock feats like Bossbane and the Idle King, shown on your profile and the leaderboard
Owner gear: the Sovereign Founder's Regalia now shimmers with a rainbow aura
New share button — brag your stats or grab the link for your videos
New "What's New" update log (this panel!) with dates for every patch

changes.text: GM console: more commands — grant titles, set stage, heal, reset player, grant XP

changes: Maintenance notices: players now see a proper maintenance screen and banner when the server is down for updates
title: UI 2.0 — damage meter, party cards & titles

changes: Fixed progression walling at boss stages (lower enemy HP/attack scaling)
Clicker mode now auto-attacks at 35% speed while idle — taps stay king
Mercy rule: dying 3× to the same boss retreats you 5 stages to farm
Boss popup now shows once per boss stage, death gold loss cut to 2%
Cheaper upgrades, richer XP and gold, stronger level gains
title: Balance patch — the boss-loop repair

changes: Staff-only GM console: grants, gift codes and roster management
Owner-only Sovereign Founder's Regalia, GM Fateweaver Regalia, Admin Warden Arsenal
Gift codes: create redeemable codes for full gear sets
title: GM console & privileged gear

changes: Tap combo meter with FRENZY mode (double tap damage for 10s)
Mastery talents: spend points earned every 10 levels
Professions: Herb Gathering and Smithing, leveled with gold
12 achievements paying stars, 10 named zones, Well-rested XP bonus
title: Progression systems

changes: Real accounts with secure login — progress follows you across devices
Durable cloud saves (PostgreSQL) — progress never resets
True global leaderboard with power, stage and boss rankings
Three modes: idle clicker, classic auto-battle, 3-hero party dungeon
Prestige at level 70 for +25% damage & gold per rebirth
